name: Business & Commercial
summary: Formation, contracts, financing and disputes for owner-managed companies and their lenders.
intro:
Most businesses we advise are owned by the people who run them. They need a lawyer who understands that a decision about a lease, a hire or a partner is also a decision about a family's income.

We help you choose the right structure, put agreements on paper while everyone still agrees, and resolve disagreements early and quietly when they arise.
handles: Choosing and forming a company, partnership or nonprofit
Commercial contracts, vendor terms and credit agreements
Buying, selling and succession of a business
Commercial leases, for tenants and landlords
Business disputes, negotiated first and litigated when needed

name: Employment Law
summary: Advice for employers on policies and compliance, and for employees on agreements, pay and workplace rights.
intro:
Work is where most people spend their days, and the rules around it are detailed. We advise small and mid-sized employers on getting the basics right, and we advise individual employees who have been handed an agreement or a decision they do not understand.

We will tell you plainly where you stand, what the options are and what each option is likely to cost.
handles: Wage and hour compliance and classification of workers
Separation negotiations for executives and employees

name: Real Estate
summary: Purchases, sales, leases, financing and title for homeowners, investors and landlords.
intro:
A property transaction is usually the largest agreement a person signs. We read the paper carefully so that you do not have to guess what you are agreeing to.

We act for buyers, sellers, landlords and tenants, and we work closely with lenders, title companies and surveyors to keep a closing on schedule.
handles: Landlord and tenant matters, including lease drafting
Title review, easements and boundary questions
Zoning and land use applications before local boards

name: Family Law
summary: Divorce, parenting arrangements, support and agreements, handled with care and a steady hand.
intro:
Family matters are personal, and the legal process around them can feel cold. We explain each step before it happens, keep you informed, and look first for solutions that spare your family a courtroom.

Where a court is unavoidable, we prepare thoroughly and keep the focus on what matters most to you and your children.

name: Estate Planning & Probate
summary: Wills, trusts and powers of attorney, and guidance for families settling an estate.
intro:
A good estate plan is a kindness to the people you leave behind. We help you decide who will make decisions if you cannot, who will receive what you have, and how to make that as simple as possible for them.

When a loved one has died, we guide families and executors through probate one practical step at a time.
handles: Powers of attorney and health care directives
Planning for a family business or real estate

name: Civil Litigation
summary: Representation in contract, property and business disputes, from first letter to trial and appeal.
intro:
Most disputes are resolved without a trial, and we work to find those resolutions when they serve you. We also prepare every matter as though it could be tried, because that preparation is what produces good settlements.

We will give you an honest assessment of strengths, weaknesses and cost before you decide how to proceed.
handles: Trial and appeal in state and federal court
